title: Multimodal Abstention That Preserves Acquired Correct Answers
abstract: arXiv:2611.14311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adding abstention to a task-adapted multimodal model can discard correct answers, including capabilities acquired during adaptation. We formulate abstention repair as maximizing correct abstention on unanswerable questions under a budget on newly lost correct answers. We propose ReFrain (Regression-Free Abstention), which combines a linear probe on first-token logits, threshold calibration on held-out image clusters, and a deterministic veto that replaces rejected outputs with the displayed "none of the above" option while preserving all other responses. "Regression-free" denotes zero loss on the calibration set at the zero-budget target. All abstention methods in our main comparison start from the same answering-SFT checkpoint; we separately track lost correct answers, repaired errors, and retained SFT gains. On Qwen2.5-VL-3B, ReFrain at zero budget retains all 57 SFT-gained answers with no losses and improves correct abstention by 7.30

translated_title: 保留已获得正确答案的多模态弃答机制
translated_abstract: 为经过任务适配的多模态模型添加弃答功能，可能会丢弃正确答案，包括适配过程中获得的能力。我们将弃答修复问题形式化为：在“新损失的正确答案”的预算约束下，最大化对不可回答问题的正确弃答率。我们提出ReFrain（无回归弃答），该方法结合了基于首token logits的线性探针、在留出图像集群上的阈值校准，以及一个确定性否决机制——用显示的“以上都不是”选项替换被拒绝的输出，同时保留所有其他响应。“无回归”指在零预算目标下，校准集上的正确答案损失为零。主要对比中的所有弃答方法均从同一个回答SFT检查点出发；我们分别跟踪损失的正确答案、修复的错误以及保留的SFT收益。在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上，ReFrain在零预算下完整保留了全部57个SFT获得的答案且零损失，同时将正确弃答率提升了7.30个百分点。
tldr: 提出ReFrain多模态弃答方法，在提升对不可回答问题正确弃答能力的同时，保证任务适配阶段获得的正确答案零损失。
en_tdlr: ReFrain is a regression-free multimodal abstention method that improves correct abstention on unanswerable questions while guaranteeing zero loss of correct answers acquired during task adaptation.
